display.purpose: Condensed project names and oversized section headings.

body.purpose: Readable project descriptions and supporting copy.

label.purpose: Dates, counters, language metadata and source notes.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: A direct project action in fluoro pink with a blue registration offset.
components.css: .ds-primary-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 18px; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 18px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--pink); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--blue); font: 800 .75rem var(--body); letter-spacing: .045em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease; } .ds-primary-action:hover { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 var(--blue); } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Outline Action
components.description: A secondary live-site action outlined in federal blue.
components.css: .ds-outline-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 18px; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 18px; color: var(--blue); border: 1px solid var(--blue); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--pink); font: 800 .75rem var(--body); letter-spacing: .045em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease; } .ds-outline-action:hover { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 var(--blue); } .ds-outline-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A compact repository search with a blue rule and pink search mark.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; min-height: 43px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid rgba(30, 79, 255, .55); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .2); } .ds-search > span { color: var(--pink); font-size: 1.2rem; } .ds-search input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; color: var(--ink); background: transparent; font: .8rem var(--body); } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: #5b5750; opacity: 1; } .ds-search:focus-within { outline: 3px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Language Chip
components.description: A small language label; color remains a supporting dot, never the whole surface.
components.css: .ds-language-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 3px 7px; border: 1px solid rgba(30, 79, 255, .3); color: var(--muted); font: .63rem var(--body); } .ds-language-chip i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--blue); }

components.name: Featured Project
components.description: A large website preview paired with project metadata and source action.

components.css: .ds-feature-print { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, .8fr) minmax(0, 1.2fr); gap: 32px; align-items: center; padding: 18px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-blue); color: var(--ink); } .ds-feature-index { grid-column: 2; color: var(--blue); font: .72rem var(--mono); } .ds-feature-print h3 { grid-column: 2; margin: 0; color: var(--blue); font: 400 2.4rem/.95 var(--display); text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-feature-print p { grid-column: 2; margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font: .95rem/1.55 var(--body); } .ds-feature-print a { grid-column: 2; width: fit-content; color: var(--ink); background: var(--pink); padding: 14px 18px; font: 800 .75rem var(--body); text-decoration: none; } @media (max-width: 680px) { .ds-feature-print { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 12px; } .ds-feature-index, .ds-feature-print h3, .ds-feature-print p, .ds-feature-print a { grid-column: 1; } }

components.name: Project Rail Tile
components.description: A compact selectable project from the featured websites.
components.css: .ds-project-tile { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 4px; min-width: 140px; min-height: 116px; padding: 8px 10px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(30, 79, 255, .3); color: var(--ink); background: transparent; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s ease, border-color .2s ease, transform .2s ease; } .ds-project-tile:hover, .ds-project-tile[aria-current="true"] { border-color: var(--blue); background: rgba(255, 210, 42, .24); } .ds-project-tile[aria-current="true"] { transform: translate(-2px, -2px); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--pink); } .ds-project-mark { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 100%; height: 71px; color: var(--blue); } .ds-project-tile strong { max-width: 100%; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font: 800 .76rem var(--body); } .ds-project-tile small { color: var(--muted); font: .58rem var(--mono); } .ds-project-tile:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Masthead Link
components.description: A quiet, bold navigation link that leaves the project work in focus.
components.css: .ds-masthead-link { color: var(--ink); font: 700 .78rem var(--body); text-decoration: none; transition: color .18s ease; } .ds-masthead-link:hover { color: var(--blue); } .ds-masthead-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
This is a living portfolio of websites and projects. Its visual style borrows from two-ink risograph printing through registration marks, color overlaps, paper-like texture and bold geometric artwork; these are visual motifs, not descriptions of the work. The public-only, automatically refreshed source data stays tactile and personal without making the site feel like a terminal or product dashboard.

The composition is editorial and work-first. Lead with featured websites, followed by the contribution calendar, community work and credentials. Keep the system honest: every project, count and link comes from public source data.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and vivid spot inks with visible, restrained grain.
Condensed display lettering paired with readable sans-serif and monospaced metadata.
Square, printed rules and hard offset shadows instead of soft floating surfaces.

rules.name: The Spot-Ink Rule
rules.body: Keep the blue, pink and sunflower distinct; use overlap and multiply blending for graphic interaction rather than inventing extra accent colors.

rules.name: The No-Terminal-Cosplay Rule
rules.body: Monospace is metadata, not a full-page costume; do not make ordinary copy or navigation look like a command line.

rules.name: The Offset-Only Rule
rules.body: Use hard offset shadows as ink registration; do not add soft elevation or blurred drop shadows.

dos: Do lead with real public projects and direct source or live-demo links.
Do honor the explicit featured repository order in portfolio.config.mjs; use GitHub pins and repository activity to fill remaining slots.
Do use the established federal-blue, fluoro-pink, sunflower, warm-paper and near-black palette.
Do keep paper-like texture and off-register layers subtle around readable text.
Do preserve keyboard operation, visible focus, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't expose private repository or contribution data, or invent testimonials, customer claims, talk lists or usage metrics.
Don't add fake terminal chrome, a generic rounded-card grid, soft dashboard shadows or unrelated accent colors.
Don't describe websites or projects as prints; the risograph influence is visual only.
Don't add trackers or runtime third-party asset requests.
